messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/decode on prod-us-west-2. p99=3.2s (baseline ~0.9s), p95=1.1s. Error rate <0.1%. Affected pools: dedicated-usw2-gpu, shared-gpu. Linked dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/decodes

alice: seeing streaming stalls — clients report chunked responses then long silence. spike started ~2391234500. p99 tail increase across multiple models (gpt-open-16k-quant, gpt-open-std).

sam: any recent infra changes? I remember a TRT/FlashAttn kernel rollout around 22:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: trt8.6-flashattn-v2 -> dedicated-usw2 (canary->100%). rollout id r-20260315-7.

jordan: we also merged compile flag -DNEW_KERNEL_SYNC last week in compiler toolchain, could be a synchronization/alloc interaction.

kai: spinning up staging with same kernel/build now. preliminary: p99 in staging up from 0.8s -> 1.6s but not as bad as prod. suspect allocator/page pinning.

maria: checking host logs: lots of host->gpu pin failures: "cuHostRegister failed: error=700" repeated. no OOMs in dmesg but high page-fault churn.

alice: customer impact: top customers (cust-A, cust-B) report timeouts at 10s, support queue +12 tickets last 30m. potential SLA exposure.

sam: mitigation: pause rollout and rollback to previous kernel. initiating rollback now: `deploy rollback r-20260315-7 --to r-20260314-3`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Expected propagation 90-120s across dedicated fleet.

incident-bot: Automatic mitigation engaged: route policy "latency-fallback" activated for Enterprise tier. Traffic for high-tail customers routed to cpu-backed fallback workers to avoid stalls.

jordan: toggled runtime flag `kernel_new_sync=false` in canary. Immediate p99 improvement in that instance. Patch pushed: `runtime.config.set("kernel_new_sync", false)`

kai: capturing perf and nvprof traces, will upload. command: `perf record -F 99 -a -g --trace-cmd` then nvprof. uploading to /tmp/2391234567-traces.tar.gz

maria: preparing customer outreach template and compiling affected request IDs. SLO window candidate: 2391234503 -> 2391234560 (approx).

alice: handoff notes (leaving in 2h): rollback completed, fallback routes active, traces collected (kai), kernel_new_sync disabled in runtime. DO NOT re-roll trt8.6.

sam: added scaling play: if p99 > 1.5s for 5m, scale dedicated burst to 2x and open emergency capacity.

kai: log snippet from worker that saw the kernel failure:

```
[23:06:07 UTC] decode: flash_attn kernel launch failed: cudaErrorUnknown: cuHostRegister failed: error=700
stack: runtime::kernel::launch -> runtime::alloc::pin_host_mem -> cuHostRegister -> CUresult=700
alloc attempts: pinned=0, fallback_pages=1
```

alice: @oncall-next please monitor overnight, escalate to SRE if p99 creep resumes. :rotating_light:

oncall-next: acknowledged. Taking over at 01:00 UTC. Handoff checklist: confirm rollback fully propagated, verify fallback routes, monitor queue/backlog, keep support updated with estimated resolution.

sam: follow-up actions: create ticket RINF-8242 to revert compile flag in build pipeline, add synthetic streaming load test for new kernels (24h before re-roll), and add additional host pinning metrics to runtime.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Postmortem owner: sam. Postmortem ETA: 72h. Channel: #incidents/2391234567

alice: leaving final note in thread: rollback verified across 100% instances at 23:09:42 UTC, p99 back to ~0.95s after fallback + rollback. continuing trace analysis.
